name: Frontend Frameworks: React/Vue
description: Building component-based user interfaces with React and Vue, from state and data fetching to SSR and production.

nodes.name: Modules & bundlers
nodes.desc: ES modules, npm, and dev servers and bundlers such as Vite.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise frontend code with ES modules, manage packages with npm and run dev servers and bundlers like Vite.
topics: Dev servers and hot module replacement

nodes.name: Component thinking
nodes.desc: Declarative UI, components, one-way data flow and why frameworks exist.
nodes.summary: You will be able to break interfaces into components with one-way data flow and explain why declarative frameworks exist.
topics: UI as a function of state

nodes.name: TypeScript for UIs
nodes.desc: Typing props, events and state in frontend code.
nodes.summary: You will be able to type props, events and state in frontend code with TypeScript to catch errors early.

nodes.name: React components
nodes.desc: JSX, props, composition, conditional rendering and lists with keys.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build React components with JSX, props and composition and render conditional content and keyed lists.

nodes.name: Hooks & state
nodes.desc: useState, useEffect, useRef and writing custom hooks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to manage state and side effects in React with useState, useEffect and useRef and write custom hooks.

nodes.name: Events & forms
nodes.desc: Handling events, controlled inputs and form validation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle events and build controlled forms with validation in React.

nodes.name: Rendering model
nodes.desc: Re-renders, reconciliation, memoisation and avoiding wasted work.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain when React re-renders, how reconciliation works and how memoisation avoids wasted work.

nodes.name: Context & global state
nodes.desc: Context, reducers and external stores for shared state.
nodes.summary: You will be able to share state across components with context, reducers and external stores.
topics: External stores like Zustand or Redux

nodes.name: Data fetching
nodes.desc: Loading states, caching, revalidation and query libraries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fetch server data with loading and error states, caching and revalidation using query libraries.

nodes.name: Routing
nodes.desc: Client-side routing, nested routes and route data.
nodes.summary: You will be able to add client-side routing with nested routes, URL parameters and route-level data loading.

nodes.name: Styling components
nodes.desc: CSS modules, utility CSS and component libraries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to style components with CSS modules, utility CSS and component libraries.

nodes.name: React SPA
nodes.desc: Build a multi-page React app with shared state and a live API.
nodes.summary: You will build a multi-page React single-page app with shared state and data from a live API.

nodes.name: Vue fundamentals
nodes.desc: Templates, directives and single-file components.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build Vue single-file components with templates, directives and props.

nodes.name: Vue reactivity
nodes.desc: ref, reactive, computed, watchers and the Composition API.
nodes.summary: You will be able to manage state in Vue with ref, reactive, computed values and watchers using the Composition API.

nodes.name: Vue Router & Pinia
nodes.desc: Routing and state management in the Vue ecosystem.
nodes.summary: You will be able to add routing with Vue Router and manage shared state with Pinia stores.

nodes.name: Vue app
nodes.desc: Rebuild a small app in Vue and compare the approaches with React.
nodes.summary: You will rebuild a small app in Vue and compare its approach to components, reactivity and state with React.

nodes.name: SSR frameworks
nodes.desc: Server rendering, static generation and hydration with Next.js and Nuxt.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose between server rendering, static generation and client rendering and use hydration in Next.js and Nuxt.

nodes.name: Testing UIs
nodes.desc: Component tests, mocking network calls and end-to-end tests.
nodes.summary: You will be able to test components, mock network calls and write end-to-end tests for frontend apps.

nodes.name: Frontend performance
nodes.desc: Code splitting, bundle size, Core Web Vitals and profiling renders.
nodes.summary: You will be able to improve frontend performance with code splitting and smaller bundles, measured by Core Web Vitals and render profiling.

nodes.name: Production frontend
nodes.desc: Ship a tested, accessible, fast app built on a meta-framework.
nodes.summary: You will ship a tested, accessible and fast application built on a meta-framework.
